author: josephtreyfit
quote:
Not as good as it should be considering the 2 billion dollar budget. It became realistic in the wrong ways and thats what made lose what used to be a fun video game. So realistic in fact you complete chores inside of a for "fun" video game. 

The hardware that cost $2billion dollars to create, which i'm being allowed to "rent" a copy of for $100, barely performs to specs my GameCube does.

author: josephtreyfit
quote: Beautiful, stunning, altruistic, generational. This game is easily my favorite game of all time. The story told is intricate and detailed, revealing more as you play.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
